description: The strongest URL of each group of competing pages, scored on clicks, history, query coverage, ranking stability, intent match, content, internal links, canonical setup and business value, with every component shown (the page with the most clicks does not always win). Uses your connected Google Search Console (read-only) plus a crawl of the site; the analysis is reused for a day. Never changes your site: redirects are proposals only. Needs an API key from a paid plan.

site.description: Search Console property, for example sc-domain:example.com or https://example.com/. Omit to use the site of your latest Page Intelligence analysis.
site.title: Site

url.description: Only the group that contains this URL.
url.title: Url
